caption:
You're exhausted from making it happen. You force every outcome with your own strength — but what if the best gift only comes to an open hand? (Galatians 3:18 devotional)

The inheritance comes by promise, not by law — God brought Isaac from a body "as good as dead," not from the striving that manufactured Ishmael. The making hand produces; the receiving hand simply takes what's given. Your inheritance is already yours by promise, bought by His self-giving — so you can unclench and receive.

📌 Save this for when you're forcing an outcome
📩 Send it to someone striving to make it all happen alone
💬 Which hand am I living from — making, or receiving?

first_comment: I'll go first — my tightest-gripped victories left me the emptiest, because I'd just built another Ishmael. What are you forcing that He actually wants to give? 🤍
